changes: p2: name normalized to 'Lakṣmīpālavarman'; 'bhallāka' (= bhalloka, later bhāro, an honorific/office title) moved to titles
p3 '(buauvarman)' removed as a separate person: 'prasiddhanāma' introduces the popular name of the donor himself, so it is an alias of p2 and is now recorded in notes

purpose: deyadharma (pious gift) for the benefit of all beings (sarvasattvārthahetu)
notes: Era not stated, but taken as NS: the catalogue says so, and Vijayakāmadeva's reign (c. NS 312) fits. Month and pakṣa are partly restored (vai⁅śā⁆〇⁅kla⁆). 'bhallāka' is the title bhalloka (later bhāro); the catalogue writes 'Lakṣmīpālavarmabhalloka'. 'prasiddhanāma śrī (buauvarman)' gives the donor's popular name. The cataloguer marked the reading as uncertain; it could be something like Bubuvarman. It is not counted as a separate person. No scribe is named.
